name: tw-dev
description: Dev-phase SDLC skills for any kind of development: orchestrate, design, coding (web, API, CLI, library, mobile, data/ML — single or multi-component with interface contracts; its test agents write ALL automated tests — full unit and integration coverage), and compliance — stack and project-type agnostic. Requirements come in as input from the tw-ba plugin (docs/ba/); manual test planning lives in the tw-qa plugin.
